# Liquid morph

Organic shapes and fluid outlines, with a grounded reading layer.

## Use

Use for creative campaigns, playful learning moments, and expressive product cards.

## Essential traits

- Organic silhouette
- Violet and pink accents
- Steady text and action placement

## Typography

System sans-serif with bold, compact headings.

## Layout and surfaces

Organic decoration around a stable, readable rectangular content zone. Rounded irregular outer shapes, saturated purple, bounded optional morphing.

## Palette

- background: #160d32
- surface: #261944
- text: #fcf5ff
- muted: #d5c0e8
- accent: #eab0ff
- border: #8c65b1

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Liquid morph to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with bold, compact headings. Organic decoration around a stable, readable rectangular content zone. Rounded irregular outer shapes, saturated purple, bounded optional morphing. Palette: background #160d32, surface #261944, text #fcf5ff, muted #d5c0e8, accent #eab0ff, border #8c65b1. Essential traits: Organic silhouette; Violet and pink accents; Steady text and action placement. Avoid: Morphing reading text; Unbounded motion; Distorted control shapes. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
